fees.description: Connection fee may apply when connecting or reconnecting electricity at your property and a site visit is required (e.g. when moving in). Fees are charged by the distributor and/or meter provider and can change from time to time; fees will vary if the request is outside business hours. See additional fee information for details.

Disconnection fee may apply when your electricity is disconnected and a site visit is required (e.g. when you move out). Fees are charged by the distributor and/or meter provider and can change from time to time; fees will vary if the request is outside business hours. See additional fee information for details.
A processing fee of 1.5% applies to domestic debit and credit card payments using Visa and Mastercard.
A processing fee of 1.75% applies to domestic debit and credit card payments using AMEX.
This fee may apply after three direct debit attempts are dishonoured by your financial institution. Your payment method may be changed to manual payment after three failed attempts.
